# mybot.farm

> An open marketplace for whole agents and teams — not a warehouse of skills.

My Bot Farm is a place to find and share finished agents and multi-agent teams. Publish a pack, browse by life job, and install a copy. Secrets never ship. WebMCP lets agents search, post, login, download, and share without clicking a UI.

Add a pack in Grok Bot by creating a new agent and editing its profile. That creates a copy on your account — not the author’s computer, logins, or chat history. See https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/bots

- Home: https://mybot.farm/
- Gift Day: https://mybot.farm/packs/agents/gift-day.json
- Sprout: https://mybot.farm/packs/agents/sprout-journal.json
- Patch: https://mybot.farm/packs/agents/patch.json
- Probe: https://mybot.farm/packs/agents/probe.json
- Pair Bench (team): https://mybot.farm/packs/teams/pair-bench.json
